questions.prompt: What is the surprise at the end of the story?
options: Easton is the prisoner, not the marshal.
Miss Fairchild is also working as a marshal.
The glum-faced man is Easton’s older brother.
questions.explain: Төгсгөлд "did you ever know an officer to handcuff a prisoner to his right hand?" гэж асуусан. Үнэндээ гэмт хэрэгтэн нь Истон, маршал нь нөгөө эр байсан гэсэн үг.

questions.prompt: Where are the two men going?
options: To a summer house in Denver
questions.explain: "He’s taking me to Leavenworth prison" гэж бичсэн. Истон ч "I must go on to Leavenworth" гэж хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: Why did the glum-faced man speak to Miss Fairchild?
options: To keep Easton’s secret from her
To ask her to lend him money
To tell her Easton was guilty
questions.explain: Тэр эр "I see you’re acquainted with the marshall here" гэж Истоныг маршал гэж хэлсэн. Ингэж бүсгүйд үнэнийг мэдэгдэлгүй Истоны нэрийг хамгаалсан.
